text:
Alex: quick question re: chat/completions streaming + tool calls — does the contract guarantee that a streaming func_call payload will always end with an 'end_marker' event? we're seeing clients drop the connection mid-func and not getting final 'tool_result'.
Maria: IIRC we don't guarantee an 'end' event currently; stream is sequence of deltas and final 'done' comes as event type 'response.complete' — but toolcall protocol uses 'tool_end' only for non-streaming. cc @TJ
TJ: the gaps in spec are real. Proposed small addition: include 'stream_event': 'tool_end' when tool execution completes, and set 'final_chunk': true on the last delta. Backcompat: default is absent, clients ignore. Can we make opt-in via header 'X-Chat-Stream-Ext: v1'?
Rachel: That seems fine. Quick compat question: older SDKs will parse deltas as text, will adding 'final_chunk' break them? probably not but need explicit docs.
Alex: I'll draft a short PR with the schema change and an example. Want feedback on wording. Also pinging @deploy-bot to plan canary route.
deploy-bot: new PR created at https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood-api/pull/4876 — run smoke tests? :rocket:
Maria: small nit — prefer 'is_final' vs 'final_chunk'. 'is_final' clearer. Also include example JSON snippet:
```
{"delta":{"tool_call":{"name":"run_query","args":"..."}}, "is_final": true, "request_id":"req-abc123"}
```
TJ: ack. Also note we should not rely on role=null behavior. For tool calls, role should be 'tool' for deltas and final result should be role 'assistant' containing tool output.
Rachel: I'll add a comment on the PR about SDK bump and add a migration note in CHANGELOG. Can we do a 2-week opt-in window? then enable by default.
Alex: timeline: PR today, 48h review, canary deploy next Tue, roll to 10% then 100% after monitoring. @TJ can you own the canary job?
TJ: I can. I'll add a smoke test that simulates mid-stream disconnect and verifies client gets 'is_final' never set — then ensure fallback to post-run webhook.
Maria: one more: streaming meta events should include 'request_id' consistently to correlate across layers. Add to schema.
Alex: agreed. I'll include request_id in the example and in the API docs update.
Rachel: LGTM. @Alex ping me when PR ready and I'll do a quick copy review.
Alex: thanks :thumbsup:
